2645-2930-3430-5233.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2930-3430-5233.description:
Activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{W}{W}{W} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Boros Garrison
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3703-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3703-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

222-527-647-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-647-3899.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3455-3680.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3455-3680.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Stunt Double and Vizier of Many Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3455-3680.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

243-4050-4893-7218.description:
Activate Reaping Willow by paying {W/B} due to Training Grounds and removing two counters from it, returning Plague Belcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Plague Belcher enters, it triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on Reaping Willow.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Plague Belcher, adding {W/B}.
Repeat.

147-2292-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-2292-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {3}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

710-6798-7424.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

2617-7012-7150.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
2617-7012-7150.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Airbender Ascension's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Airbender Ascension's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1792-2146-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1792-2146-4404.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Cloud Key.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

2921-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1806-2060-3129-5256-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

628-4050-7211.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

276-791-3693-7186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
276-791-3693-7186.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-1358-3334-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Sydri
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-3980-4311-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sisay's Ring.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-851-1270-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-851-1270-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

3284-3944-4871-5258.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adidng {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Korvold and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw Blood Pet from your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, causing you to create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
Repeat.

325-2275-4067-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-2275-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

338-2060-3490-3910-6441.easyPrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
338-2060-3490-3910-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
338-2060-3490-3910-6441.description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Repeat.

575-2034-5918.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other nontoken creature.
575-2034-5918.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate the creature by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Hauntwoods Shrieker by paying {1}{G}, turning the creature face-up.
Repeat.

1636-3484-4023-4050-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Dr Madison Li does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least five energy counters.
1636-3484-4023-4050-4840.description:
Activate Dr Madison Li's third ability by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlepshere enters the battlefield, it, Intruder Alarm and Decoction Module triggers.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Decoction Module trigger four times.
Resolve all Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve all Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

632-2178-4659-4840.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Scarecrone.
Scarecrone does not have summoning sickness.
632-2178-4659-4840.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Battlesphere dies, triggering Scarecrone, untapping Scarecrone.
Activate Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Myr token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1684-2034-2178-2557-3263.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1684-2034-2178-2557-3263.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {1} and tapping it to create two Elemental token with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental token, adding {C}{C}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
